Who would just leave random traps everywhere? Agh! Are they trying to collapse the cave?
Maybe we should have left them alone. The horde is starting to follow us down here. Create a choke point and hold them back. We need a plan.
Dispatcher, do you read? Of course not. There has to be somewhere where we can—
Hey! Who do you think you are, setting off my mines like that
?!? You got rocks for brains or somethin'?
Great. It's *this* guy. I didn't want to get out of here alive anyway.
Mr. Unexcitable. Still the same depressing lump of zombie guts, huh? It's good to see you too.
We need a way to the city. Are you able to take us there?

Hold on — one's getting close. Hee-yup! Haha! Anyway, of course I can! I've been working these mines for years, well before these freaks showed up. There's an entrance to this cave not far from here. Just — ah... just don't step on anything with whatever you're trying to keep.
Why are you down here anyway? The last time I saw you — you were arguing with the recruitment officer about being kicked out of training.

Because he was blaming me for letting one of the guys step in a bear trap! Sure, it might've been me, but not that they could prove it. Turns out I have a gift and the city needs crystals. So I stay in that little hut over there for a few days and make sure things are safe. For the most part.
Gotcha! Ah— bleh. I think I just tasted some of its thoughts. Honestly, I thought there'd be more of ya! Lots of weird voices coming from the mines today. Heard some before you guys set off my mine.
Voices? Wait. Are there other ways into the mine?
Yeah, some even connect to the river since we gotta wash the crystals off, but... uh. Should you be worrying about that right now?
Take us to where the city is. We need to get in contact with headquarters and get out of the cave. I'm starting to hear more of your traps go off.
Ugh. Great. Follow me! Before you guys end up giving me even more work. Especially you, Minigunner.
Come on, Recruit! Whatever's behind us isn't slowing down. I've never seen a horde like this.
The way they're moving has me thinking something is leading them.
Go with the rest of the team. We'll be right behind you!
One icon and dialogue is randomly chosen upon defeat:
•Mission Failed, we'll get em' next time.
•Mistakes are just part of the journey..
